title: First Foo Fighter reports, November 1944
summary: Merrick von Renenamp tells of First Foo Fighter reports, November 1944, about 1944 at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: anniversary of the first reports of Foo Fighters. Like that happened November of 1944.

plain: Merrick von Renenamp, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, marks an anniversary: he says the first reports of "Foo Fighters" came in November 1944. Foo Fighters was the nickname for strange lights that wartime pilots said they saw near their planes. He brings up the date because, to him, those reports are where the modern story of unexplained objects in the sky begins.
